_comment: Transcribed from in-game screens captured 2026-08-05 (Steam captures 20260805170353 NATO art, 170349 Combat Medic, 170350 Fire Support). The class active ability is recorded once on the class rather than on each training path because both path screens show the same LVL 03 entry. The Pax Armata portrait was not captured in this run, so its variant figure renders as pending rather than borrowing the NATO shot.
name: Support
_alias_note: No bare "support" alias. EA uses the word constantly in prose ("controller support", "support for"), so it would tag dozens of unrelated lines. "support fire" is EA's own inversion of the Fire Support training path, published in 1.3.2.0; 1.1.3.0 gets it the right way round. Carried as an alias so the line still connects, same pattern as the other as-published names. No "steady aim" alias: 1.2.1.0 uses that exact phrase for the bolt-action hold-breath prompt, which is a different mechanic from the Fire Support ability of the same name.

description.text: The backbone of any combat unit for defense and sustained fighting. Heal and resupply friendly forces, while fortifying defensive positions to keep them protected.

ability.name: Restock Allies
ability.description: Resupply and heal nearby friendly forces for 10 seconds. Reviving teammates takes only 1.7 seconds.

training_paths.name: Combat Medic
training_paths.description: Elite practitioners in battlefield medicine. Heal casualties to quickly get them back in the fight and provide cover with more efficient defensive gadgets.

abilities.name: Defense-Focused
abilities.description: Defensive gadgets have a +25% resupply rate. GPDIS and MP-APS intercept two more projectiles and tracking duration is extended by 5s. Deployable Cover takes 10% less damage.

abilities.name: Revive Recovery
abilities.description: Reviving downed teammates triggers passive health regeneration. Incoming damage temporarily halts the effect for 1s.

abilities.name: Urgent Aid
abilities.description: Drag downed soldiers 20% faster and revive them 2.5s quicker.

training_paths.name: Fire Support
training_paths.description: Skilled in enemy suppression tactics. Keep ammo restocked and utilize better weapon control to lay down cover fire and help push the attack.

abilities.name: Steady Aim
abilities.description: Improved weapons control when shooting from mounted positions.

abilities.name: Explosives Resistant
abilities.description: 25% reduction on incoming explosive splash damage while prone or shooting from mounted positions.

abilities.name: Logistics Expert
abilities.description: Faster ammo resupply when using the Supply Bag.

_tag_name_note: The bare word "support" is ordinary English and matched 32 lines about DLSS support, bot support and support for capture points, none of which are about the class. Name matching is off; the phrasings that really do mean the class are aliases instead, so a future "Support soldiers now..." line is still caught.

redsec._source: Transcribed from the in-game REDSEC class details screen, Steam capture 20260812180245. The lobby banner reads 33/100 players, so this is a Battle Royale lobby and not core multiplayer.

signature_set.name: Supply Bag
signature_set.description: Once dropped, the bag resupplies all nearby infantry with ammo for gadgets and weapons and regenerates health more efficiently, even when under fire. Gadget resupply does not occur in Battle Royale.

signature_set.name: Smoke Grenade Launcher
signature_set.description: Fires impact-triggered grenades designed to create temporary smoke screens. Blocks ability to spot targets and clears spotted markers from all infantry inside the smoke radius. Can be carried standalone or underslung on weapons with a Gadget Mount attachment for faster access.

signature_set.name: LMG Proficiency
signature_set.description: Faster transition to aim down sights (ADS) and no sprint speed penalty when carrying LMGs.

signature_set.name: Field Sustainment
signature_set.description: Distribute health packs to teammates when they directly interact with you.

passive.name: Stockpile
passive.description: Class gadget resupply rate increases by 10% with each improvement. Effect resets upon death.

training.name: Hemostatic Smoke
training.description: Smoke Grenade Launcher speeds up revival to 2.2s for all classes, provides 12.5hp/s health regen after 2.5s, and slows downed bleedout.

training.name: Swift Aid
training.description: Drag downed soldiers 20% faster and revive them 2.5s quicker. Sprint faster when under heavy fire.

training.name: Supply Line
training.description: Armor carrying capacity increased by 2 plates. Ammo carrying capacity increased for all ammo types.

universal_equipment.name: Upgraded Armor
universal_equipment.description: Standard small-arms issue tactical vest insert. Provides base-line ballistic protection.

universal_equipment.name: Thermite Sabotage
universal_equipment.description: Improvised sabotage device which slowly damages a tank and its crew.

redsec._training_note: The path this belongs to is not recorded. Only the CLASS DETAILS screen was captured for this class, and it prints the equipped path's abilities without naming the path; the SELECT TRAINING PATH screen, which names it, was captured for Assault and Engineer only. So these three abilities are known to be one path's, and which one is not.
